documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive Limited reported consolidated net revenue growth of 49.6% YOY for H1 FY27, outperforming overall two-wheeler industry growth. Absolute EBITDA for H1 FY27 stood at Rs. 348 Crore, though EBITDA margin percentage was lower due to pass-through alloy prices. The company commenced commercial production and regular supply of High Pressure Die Casted (HPDC) alloy wheels to a Japanese customer in August 2026. Additionally, a 11.55 MWp captive solar power plant in Rajasthan was operationalised in October 2026.

guidance.claim: The company revised its full-year revenue growth guidance to high-teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: Export revenue is projected to increase by 20% this year.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reported that its revenue growth outperformed two-wheeler industry growth in Q2 and H1 FY27.
Domestic demand is described as robust with resilient private consumption.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remains robust, private consumption is resilient, and the Government of India's structural reforms, particularly GST 2.0, continue to energize the broader economy and, importantly for us the automobile sector, given its deep forward and backward linkages.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall two-wheeler vehicle production registered a year-on-year growth of 22.8% in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler segment, which is most relevant to us, recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis, with total two-wheeler production of 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, up from 59.50 lakh units in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Aluminum prices are expected to remain benign in upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: However, with aluminum prices expected to remain benign in the coming quarters, we anticipate an improvement in our EBITDA margins.

demand_outlook.claim: ASK Automotive achieved consolidated revenue growth of 52.1% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.
The company recorded its highest ever quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Highest ever Quarterly Revenue, EBITDA & PAT

capex_expansion.claim: ASK Automotive commenced commercial production of alloy wheels.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial Production of Alloy Wheel commenced.

capex_expansion.claim: Regular supply of High Pressure Die Casted alloy wheels to a leading Japanese customer commenced on August 3, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Regular supply of High Pressure Die Casted (HPDC) Alloy Wheel commenced on 3rd August 2026 to our leading Japanese customer under technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan.

capex_expansion.claim: A captive solar power plant of 11.55 MWp in Rajasthan was operationalised in October 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Captive Solar power plant of 11.55 MWp in Rajasthan operationalised in Oct-26.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner is ready to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for the year may reach around Rs. 700 crore due to new plant requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant is being set up in Bangalore on a war footing to be operationalized before March.
capex_expansion.quote: That is the need that we have to urgently set up for the new orders that have come. We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan was implemented at the Karoli plant and supplies of high pressure die casted alloy wheels have commenced.
capex_expansion.quote: Happy to share that the technical collaboration with Kyushu Yanagawa Japan has been successfully implemented at our Karoli plant and 1st Supply of High Pressure Die Casted Alloy Wheel has started to our leading Japanese customer.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA improvement was supported by increasing capacity utilisation at Karoli and the new Bangalore facility.
margins_costs.quote: Benefit from increasing capacity utilisation at Karoli and new Bangalore facility

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for the quarter reached Rs. 164 crore, representing a 32.7% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with 32.7% year-on-year growth.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew by 28.8% year-on-year to Rs. 85 crore.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved PAT of Rs. 85 crore with 28.8% year-on-year growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew by 32.7% and PAT grew by 28.8% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.

orders_capacity.claim: ASK Automotive introduced HPDC alloy wheels in 2 wheelers in India for the first time.
orders_capacity.quote: First time HPDC alloy wheels introduced in 2 wheelers in India.

orders_capacity.claim: Wheel Assembly sales became nil with effect from April 1, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: With effect from 01.04.2026, WA Sales are Nil

orders_capacity.claim: Confirmed orders for alloy wheels stand at Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore for the current financial year and about Rs. 250 crore for the next financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Export revenue from Ford Motors is expected to be about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year and increase to Rs. 60 crore next year.
orders_capacity.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant increased from 60-65% in the previous quarter to about 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: happy to share that against the installed capacity in Karoli plant, from 60% to 65% that we were in the last quarter, we have now gone up to about 75%, and we are confident that in the last Q4, we will be around 80% of the capacity utilization

orders_capacity.claim: A 9.9 MWp solar power plant for captive consumption has been operationalized.
orders_capacity.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

orders_capacity.claim: Wheel assembly sales became nil effective April 1, 2026 due to strategic closure.
orders_capacity.quote: *With effect from 01.04.2026, WA Sales are Nil

capital_allocation.claim: Internal accruals will be supplemented by external term loans for machinery financing.
capital_allocation.quote: We are actually keeping in mind our high mid-teen growth, our internal accruals will be sufficient; but yes, for cash flow management, we will have to take some external financing.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt-to-equity ratio is projected to remain under control and not exceed 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital requirements increased due to sudden commodity price increases.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, it has increased, because due to sudden increase in working capital requirement due to commodity price increase, so there is an increase in debt.

risks_headwinds.claim: Strategic reduction in wheel assembly had a negative impact of 5.0% on Q2 FY27 revenue.
Geopolitical conflict in West Asia caused undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages because of the denominator effect.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in alloy prices may affect margin percentages due to the denominator effect.

management_commitments.claim: The company operationalised an 11.55 MWp captive solar power plant in Rajasthan.
management_commitments.quote: Captive Solar power plant of 11.55 MWp in Rajasthan operationalised in Oct-26.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to operationalize its new plant in Bangalore before March.
management_commitments.quote: that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Initial sunroof cable supplies will start from the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Initial supplies will start from H2, but next year, you will see substantial growth there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
